operator.text:
Plan for Bandwidth:
  Radio: Retevis C62/C2 (radios/c62.yaml), firmware fmbw-882f7f0c
  Bench: k0ret, receiver rtlsdr, transmitter hackrf, calibration assumed of 2026-10-20
  2m: 146.580 MHz (to receiver 58.4 dB, from transmitter 58.5 dB)
  70cm: 445.975 MHz (to receiver 58.0 dB, from transmitter 58.3 dB)
  Modes: fm, m17
  Transmit tests: attenuator chain from the radio to the rtlsdr
  Tests (10):
    - 2m: FM TX At 25 kHz Stays Within Wide Limits
    - 2m: FM TX At 12.5 kHz Stays Within Narrow Limits
    - 2m: Narrow FM TX Deviates Less Than Wide
    - 2m: FM Bandwidth Survives An M17 Round Trip
    - 2m: CTCSS Deviation Follows The Bandwidth
    - 70cm: FM TX At 25 kHz Stays Within Wide Limits
    - 70cm: FM TX At 12.5 kHz Stays Within Narrow Limits
    - 70cm: Narrow FM TX Deviates Less Than Wide
    - 70cm: FM Bandwidth Survives An M17 Round Trip
    - 70cm: CTCSS Deviation Follows The Bandwidth
Check the setup, then continue to begin.
Set the radio to FM, 146.580 MHz, 25 kHz bandwidth, low power, no CTCSS, programming cable out

Play runs/bandwidth/bench-Bandwidth/tone-1000hz.wav at a fixed volume and distance from the mic, key PTT for 5 s, release. Then key PTT, whistle loudly close to the mic for 5 s, release. Leave a second of silence before keying up and after the last release, then press Enter.
Set the radio to FM, 146.580 MHz, 12.5 kHz bandwidth, low power, no CTCSS

Play the same tone at the same volume and distance, key PTT for 5 s, release. Then key PTT, whistle loudly close to the mic for 5 s, release. Leave a second of silence before keying up and after the last release, then press Enter.
Set the radio to FM, 146.580 MHz, 12.5 kHz bandwidth, low power, then switch to M17 and back to FM
Play the same tone at the same volume and distance, key PTT for 5 s, release. Leave a second of silence before keying up and after the last release, then press Enter.
